coder_notes: Paediatric-focused HGG trial (age <=21; stdAges CHILD, ADULT); EARLY_PHASE1. Glioblastoma named only as an example histology in inclusion ('such as'). Standard backbone chemotherapy (BABYPOG or HIT-SKK) or focal RT is given only to some patients (PR/SD after 2 cycles; by age); chemotherapy agents are not individually registered interventions or named, so not listed as agents. Regimen coded combination because the experimental arm can include chemotherapy or radiotherapy after monotherapy lead-in; monotherapy lead-in could also argue for monotherapy.
